Verifying the outline confirms the walls are consistent on all sides and corners are clear, so I mark (3,0) and (3,1) as fillable, then move on to check the next candidate region around rows 4-6, cols 8 onward.

Now I'm tracing the boundary of another region around rows 4-7, cols 8-13, where the empty cells seem to extend irregularly into row 7 before hitting walls, so I need to map out exactly which cells belong to this shape.

After checking rows 7-8 more carefully, I see this region isn't a clean rectangle either, since the wall pattern shifts across columns. There's also a separate irregular cluster in rows 4-7 near cols 15-17. I'm compiling the final list of fill cells needed: (3,0),(3,1), (9-10,6-8), (8-10,14-15), and (14,1).
